mapper.select: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN cert_status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN cert_status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approvedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN cert_status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejectedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN cert_status = 'PENDING' AND YEARWEEK(created_at) = YEARWEEK(NOW()) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekNewCount FROM hr_company

SELECT id, name, industry, scale, address, business_license_url, cert_status, cert_reject_reason, created_at FROM hr_company
AND cert_status = #{certStatus}
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.industry, c.scale, c.address, c.business_license_url AS businessLicenseUrl, c.cert_status, c.cert_reject_reason AS certRejectReason, c.created_at, cert.business_license_url AS certBusinessLicenseUrl, cert.cert_material_url AS certMaterialUrl, cert.reviewed_at AS certTime, u.name AS contactPerson, u.phone AS contactPhone FROM hr_company c LEFT JOIN hr_company_certification cert ON cert.company_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = cert.applicant_id WHERE c.id = #{id} ORDER BY cert.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT c.id, c.name AS companyName, c.industry, c.scale, c.address, c.cert_status AS certStatus, c.business_license_url AS licenseUrl, cert.cert_material_url AS certMaterialUrl, cert.created_at AS applyTime, u.name AS applicantName, u.phone AS contactPhone FROM hr_company c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cc.company_id, cc.applicant_id, cc.cert_material_url, cc.created_at FROM hr_company_certification cc INNER JOIN ( SELECT company_id, MAX(created_at) AS max_created_at FROM hr_company_certification GROUP BY company_id ) latest ON latest.company_id = cc.company_id AND latest.max_created_at = cc.created_at ) cert ON cert.company_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = cert.applicant_id
AND c.cert_status = #{certStatus}
AND c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY cert.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE hr_company SET cert_status = 'APPROVED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND cert_status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE hr_company SET cert_status = 'REJECTED', cert_reject_reason = #{reason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND cert_status = 'PENDING'
